title: Orkeon/orkeon

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

description: MyAgent — AI coding agent for the terminal. Edits code, runs commands, and plans tasks locally or through a remote server — in the CLI, a Chrome extension, or a browser playground. title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

title: CowDogMoo/squad
description: Squad runs unattended AI agents, defined as markdown plus YAML, against any LLM provider in bounded, cost-capped tool loops - locally or on Docker, Kubernetes, or EC2.

title: adecubed/gigamail
description: Mail for AI agents ( and humans). MCP server giving Claude (or any agent) safe, permission-controlled access to email (Microsoft Graph + IMAP), calendar and your knowledge files. title: amromawad/torquantis-mcp
description: Sell work for USDC with your LLM key, or buy it: reference seller, agent and x402 buyer for Torquantis, the AI agent work exchange (MCP over HTTP, Base)

description: A headless, multi-provider AI agent harness — embed it as a library, script it from the CLI, or run it as a stateful agent server. One orchestrator drives every major LLM provider.

title: yangwinnietang/Agent-Skill-Automated-circuit-diagram-synthesis
description: Developed an AI agent skill for automated circuit diagram synthesis, enabling LLM-based agents to generate electrical schematics from textual descriptions or photos

title: 99percentgrip/agent-vesper
description: Agent Vesper is a pure-Rust AI agent harness that remembers you across conversations. It provides a provider-neutral runtime where any LLM provider can plug in — today it ships with the Z.ai GLM adapter, tomorrow any provider can join with zero TUI or runtime changes.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm

title: Akash010203/sovereign-ai-workbench

title: aunysillyme/model-orchestrator
